name: workshop
description: Workshop monorepo root. Exists to declare the npm workspaces so @workshop/ui resolves by package name rather than by reaching into another workspace's source tree.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @workshop/ui && cd frontend && tsc -b --noEmit

//overrides: One React for the whole workspace. packages/ui declares react/react-dom as
peers at '>=18', which is right for a library and dangerous for an install:
npm 7+ auto-installs peers, so with no lockfile it resolves the NEWEST match
and hoists React 19 to the root while frontend keeps its own 18. A downstream
instance hit exactly that. It builds anyway, because vite resolves frontend's
local copy first, until any resolution-order change turns it into 'Invalid
hook call'. Pin here rather than narrowing the kit's peer range, so the kit
stays honest about what it supports and the install stays single-copy.
